title: Selected phrase and MYRMELEONTIDAE: five word-sum candidates
question: Do the selected PROVE WORTHIER FIND TRUTHS and MYRMELEONTIDAE candidates admit their proposed sums under the baseline rules?
summary: All five selected targets are achievable across ten segmentations. MYRMELEONTIDAE totals 809 with EO combined and A/E separate; combining both pairs gives 746.

scope.representation: Five supplied Latin words, uppercase with V replaced by U; exact GP Latin-label segmentations.
scope.procedure: Enumerate all segmentations, sum prime values, and compare each with its supplied target.
scope.parameters: Fixed five candidates; ten complete segmentations; no dictionary expansion.
scope.exclusions: Other words, synonyms, alternate spellings, altered rune values, key searches, manuscript decryption and statistical significance.

finding: Five selected targets match; ten complete segmentations retained. The 809 candidate requires mixed treatment of EO and AE, so its sum is not fixed by the Latin spelling.
limitations: Selected candidate list; no unbiased match-rate estimate, dictionary search or manuscript decryption. Computational review; human review pending.
next_steps: Group alternate vocabulary or transliteration rules as explicit variants. Define a separate bounded transform before using candidates as cipher keys.
